values.meaning: Best Friend bonus on-hit damage buff duration
values.quote: grants her ''Best Friend'' {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} {{tip|on-hit}} for 5 seconds

values.meaning: channel/acceleration timing to reach empowered state
values.quote: '''Yuumi''' {{tip|channels}} for up to {{fd|1.35}} seconds to steer the missile at a slower speed. After being in flight for the same duration, the missile accelerates in its current direction for {{fd|0.5}} seconds

mechanics.claim: Fires a missile in the target direction that deals magic damage to the first enemy hit.
mechanics.quote: fires an errant missile in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit

mechanics.claim: While attached to an ally, Yuumi channels to steer the missile, after which it accelerates and deals increased damage against champions.
mechanics.quote: '''Yuumi''' {{tip|channels}} briefly to steer the missile, after which it accelerates to deal increased damage and apply a stronger slow to champions

mechanics.claim: With Feline Friendship (Best Friend) active, the ability always applies its enhanced slow and hitting a champion grants bonus on-hit magic damage for 5 seconds.
mechanics.quote: Always applies the stronger {{tip|slow}} and grants her ''Best Friend'' bonus on-hit damage for a few seconds.

mechanics.claim: The Best Friend bonus on-hit damage is increased by Anchor's critical strike chance, up to a maximum amplification.
mechanics.quote: increased by {{pp|0 to 75 for 11|0 to 100|key=%|key1=%|type=''Anchor's'' critical strike chance|color=critical strike chance}}

mechanics.claim: Cooldown starts on-cast when unattached, starts post-effect when attached, and starts immediately when detaching.
mechanics.quote: Starts on-cast when unattached, starts post-effect when attached, starts immediately when detaching

mechanics.claim: The ability can be buffered 0.5 seconds before it comes off cooldown.
mechanics.quote: ''Prowling Projectile'' can be buffered {{fd|0.5}} seconds before it comes off cooldown.

mechanics.claim: The missile can be blocked by spell shields.
